title: Faculty Lounge

title: Comedy Tonight

title: Kismet Comedy
price_label: $10 at the door · cash or Venmo
description: Tuesday stand-up at Starr Bar in Bushwick. Ten dollars at the door, a lineup that changes every week, and a bar that keeps serving through the show.
source_label: Starr Bar events page (Kismet Comedy listing)
verification_note: Starr Bar's /events page lists Kismet Comedy on Tuesday, September 15th at 8:30pm with '🔮💫KISMET COMEDY🔮💫 ... $10 tickets at the door cash or Venmo 🎟️ You're destined to be there 💫'. The page title 'Starr Bar Events' confirms it's the venue's own calendar. Cadence set to 'Every Tuesday' as the cleanest recurring weekly stand-up slot on the venue's page; other recurring Starr Bar items (Art vs Life Open Mic biweekly Mondays, HRTuesday! last Tuesdays, weekly salsa social) are not stand-up showcases and are held out.

verification_note: Showcases page lists Friday Night SESH Showcases through October 2026 (Sep 18 8:45pm, Sep 25 8:30pm, Oct 2 8:45pm). Doors 15 min before showtime, $7 fee, BYOB friendly with no drink minimum.

title: Kweendom
price_label: Free · donations to an LGBTQ org each week
description: Pete's Candy Store's weekly LGBTQ showcase: stand-up, storytelling, characters and the occasional song, with a collection each week for a different LGBTQ organization. Free, and the back room is tiny, so early is better.
